thread:
ivy_sales: Orca POC blocked — rerank call returning 400 embedding-dims error and sporadic 413s when they push large candidate lists. Can we swarm? :eyes:
ben_engineer: Paste the exact error + a sanitized request if possible.
ivy_sales: Their ops sent this snippet (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query_embedding": [0.01, 0.02, ...],
  "candidates": [[...], [...]],
  "rerank_model": "rerank-pro"
}

HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 320"
}
```
rosa_ml: 1536 vs 320 — sounds like a very compact internal embed or heavy compression. Also 413s can come from base64 blobs inflating payloads.
kai_se: Quick checks for them: run `print(len(query_embedding))` and `print(type(candidates[0][0]))` on the client. If vectors are strings they might be base64. If len==320, that's confirmed.
ivy_sales: They replied: len=320 and some codepaths convert arrays to base64 strings for streaming.
ben_engineer: Options to unblock: 1) Server-side embedding for POC — send raw text and set `embed_on_server=true` so we produce 1536 vectors before rerank. 2) Client migrate to our 1536 embed. 3) As a last resort we can offer a temporary 320->1536 linear projection for POC (quality warning).
rosa_ml: Perf note: server-side embed costs extra and adds latency ~100-180ms per 200 candidates. For demo/POC recommend prefilter (client-side embed -> ANN top-K 300) then rerank, or use a smaller reranker.
ikai_se: Tell them to gzip and chunk candidates to avoid 413s. Example chunker: `for c in chunks(candidates,200): post_rerank(c)`
ivy_sales: They want a quick cURL to try server-side embed right now.
ben_engineer: cURL to test (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"raw_documents":["doc1 text","doc2 text"], "query":"user query", "rerank_model":"rerank-pro", "embed_on_server":true, "max_candidates":200}'
```
ivy_sales: They ran it — dims error cleared. Latency increased ~130ms for 200 candidates; they accepted for the demo but asked about cost and Dedicated.
rosa_ml: For POC credits sales can offer a limited embedding credit (typical 30-50% off up to a cap). Dedicated removes noisy rate limits and gives reserved capacity but requires contract + security review.
eli_sec: Security: if they send PII via server-side embed, we need NDA before ingesting sensitive data. For Dedicated we need the infosec questionnaire, SSO details, and KMS arrangement if they want customer-managed keys. I'll share SOC2 + questionnaire.
kai_se: Next steps I can take: 1) Enable a short-lived `embed_on_server` flag for org-orca if sales confirms org id. 2) Provide a small client patch to normalize base64 -> float arrays. 3) Send chunking/ gzip guidance and a short note on tradeoffs.
ops_bot: Feature flag "embed_on_server" enabled for org-orca at 2028-06-18T11:12:34Z
ivy_sales: Thanks everyone — Orca will run demo later today and report latency/accuracy. I'll start the POC credit + NDA threads. :thumbsup:
